Name: JP's Friendship System (Add-on)
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][center][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Friendship System[/u][/color][/i][/b][/center][/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because friendship is made, not earned... Unless you use cheat mods lol[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b][i][color=#00ffff]This mod is an add-on for my main mod, [/color][color=#ffff00]“Hardew Valley”[/color][color=#00ffff], which significantly increases the game's difficulty. However, you can still use it without needing that mod. [/color][/i][/b][/size]



[size=3][b]This mod allows you to modify how many heart points you receive from NPCs in actions such as giving gifts, teasing them, etc., allowing you to advance faster/slower in your relationship with them. [/b][/size]



[i][color=#00ff00][size=5][b]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/b][/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
